text:
maria_marketing: Heads up — we keep seeing inbound leads get claimed then sit in 'enriching' forever when HS enrichment times out. Affected ~2% of leads but they pile up (~6–12h) and block owner rotation. Can we do a heartbeat probe + dead-letter flow?

jason_salesops: +1. Can you share rough volume/TTL? Also we should consider changing the round-robin claim TTL so owners don't hold slots during enrich retries. @li_engineering fyi. :eyes:

maria_marketing: Volume ~120 leads/hr for the campaign, enrichment failures ~2% (API timeouts). When enrich fails the claim still shows as active so the rotation doesn't hand it off. Observed cases where owner never touches and it sits ~8–10h.

li_engineering: I can implement a lightweight heartbeat probe that checks owner_last_touch + enrich_status and moves leads into a DLQ if enrich failed X times OR last_touch > TTL. Suggest probe every 5m.

emma_revops: That DLQ should trigger two things: 1) push to an SDR-fallback pool for manual triage if TTL > 30m, 2) post a compact message to #marketing-inbound with link + reason. Also update the HS workflow to set a "needs-manual-enrich" property.

jason_salesops: For round-robin we should: reduce claim TTL from 60m -> 15m for inbound campaigns, add claim-jitter so simultaneous bursts don't starve rotation, and add immediate fallback if enrich fails 2x.

maria_marketing: Sounds good. Edge case: what if owner is on PTO and out-of-office is set? We don't want to reassign someone explicitly on leave.

li_engineering: We'll check owner_out_of_office flag (we already sync OOO from calendar once/day). If OOO true then move to SDR-pool immediately rather than reassign.

li_engineering: Pseudo snippet of the probe logic:```python
# heartbeat probe (very rough)
for lead in HS.query("enrich_status:failed OR enrolling AND claim_time < now - 15m"):
    if lead.enrich_retries >= 2 or lead.owner_last_touch < now - HEARTBEAT_TTL:
        if lead.owner_out_of_office:
            move_to_queue(lead, "sdr_fallback")
        else:
            set_property(lead, "needs_manual_enrich", True)
            move_to_dead_letter_topic(lead)
            notify_channel("#marketing-inbound", lead.id, reason="enrich_failed")
```

jason_salesops: That looks good. On the HS side we can add a workflow that listens for needs_manual_enrich and sets owner to null after 30m, plus a field for enriched_by to track manual fixes.

emma_revops: I'll open a HubSpot workflow change and a Salesforce sync task — will include steps, acceptance criteria, and a playbook for SDRs (how to triage DLQ leads). ETA EOD tomorrow for the RFC.

maria_marketing: Priorities agreed: 1) DLQ + Slack notify 2) heartbeat probe (5m job) 3) round-robin TTL -> 15m + jitter 4) update playbook + HS workflow.

ops-bot: scheduled job created: inbound-heartbeat-probe v1 -> cron: */5 * * * * (staging).

jason_salesops: I'll test with a small sample and report back. If probe works we flip to prod. :thumbsup:

maria_marketing: Thanks team — can we sync for 15m after Emma posts the RFC? I'll make a calendar invite. :calendar:
